topic.title: Getting Started
topic.shortdesc: Installing the plugin, running your first transformation, and understanding the output.

section.title: Prerequisites
section.p: Before installing the plugin, ensure your environment meets the following requirements:

ul.li: DITA-OTinstallationDITA Open Toolkit 4.4 or later. The plugin uses features introduced in DITA-OT 4.x, including the updated plugin installation mechanism and Gradle-based build system.
JavarequirementsJava 17 or later. Required for the DITA-OT runtime and for the plugin's Java utilities (EPUB packaging, font obfuscation, image optimization).

Sufficient disk space. A typical transformation produces an EPUB file of 500 KB to 5 MB, depending on image and font content. The temporary working directory may require up to 10x the final file size during processing.

section.note: The plugin has not been tested with Java versions earlier than 17. If you encounter UnsupportedClassVersionError exceptions, upgrade your Java installation.

section.title: Installation
section.p: The dita2epub plugininstallationplugin can be installed from a local ZIP file or from the DITA-OT plugin registry:
section.codeblock:
## Install from a local ZIP archive dita install dita2epub-1.5.0.zip
## Or install from the plugin registry dita install io.github.jyjeanne.dita2epub
section.p: After installation, verify that the epub3 transtype is available:
You should see epub3 listed among the available transformation types.

section.title: Understanding the Output
section.p: A successful transformation produces a single .epub file. Inside, the structure mirrors the EPUB 3 architecture described earlier:
